【原视频简介】
In this video, I rank the world’s most capable AI models from 2020 to 2026 using the Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI).

For older models not included in Epoch’s current leaderboard, scores were reconstructed using Epoch’s historical benchmark data and official public ECI calculation method. For newer models, scores were taken directly from Epoch’s official ECI dataset. Duplicate evaluations and closely related variants were consolidated using Epoch’s model-group system.

The ECI is designed to measure the general capabilities of frontier AI models across a range of tasks and benchmarks, it obviously has it flaws.

Each model keeps the score associated with its release, allowing the ranking to show how the AI frontier evolved over time.


🏆 Leading AI models in 2026:

1) GPT-5.5 Pro
2) Claude Fable 5
3) GPT-5.5
4) Grok 4
5) o4-mini

Sources: Epoch AI / Epoch Capabilities Index, official model announcements, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, DeepSeek, Meta, Alibaba, Mistral AI.
